systems.system: Biometric passport and national identity card production (Semlex, then GenKey)
systems.country_label: papiers biométriques (passeport et carte nationale d'identité)
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Intérieur; produced by Semlex from 2007 to March 2026, GenKey from then
systems.tiers: Production on Ngazidja; GenKey promises to decentralise to Ndzuani and Mwali; enrolment suspended from 2 March 2026, due to resume 27 March

note: The document concerns the handover of the biometric identity-document database from Semlex to the government on 24 March 2026, an identity system; it states nothing about civil registration.
